environment.hardware: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (2 GB RAM)
environment.hardware_role: Benchmark and integration-test hardware only; not a recommendation or minimum requirement.

workload.manual_control: synthetic handoff only; no real authentication

metric_definitions.memory_values: Per-run phase medians in MiB. Null means no usable measurement, never zero.
metric_definitions.pss_scope: Sum of browser, egress and ingress process groups; excludes Docker daemon and other services.
metric_definitions.rss_scope: Sum across processes; shared pages may be counted more than once.
metric_definitions.browser_raw_mib: Browser cgroup raw memory charge; file cache is reported separately, not subtracted to claim savings.
metric_definitions.tool_elapsed_ms: All measured calls, including rejected requests. For success-only summary, exclude an entire run-phase if errors contains that phase.
metric_definitions.oom_deltas: Per-run memory.events increments for the named role; max is not an OOM-kill counter.
metric_definitions.sampling: Per-second raw samples remain private; this public export contains per-run phase summaries.

limitations: One live page, fixed rotating order, cache, network and different Python patch versions limit causal claims.
Baseline runs 1 and 2 refused the extra tab, so manual-control workloads differ.
All variants refused the long full-page image in all three runs at this budget.
Previous partial sets are excluded. No permanent deployment or native migration was performed.
MCP image delivery is not evidence that web ChatGPT understood an image.
